Dry-stone wall
A wall of stones fitted together dry, without mortar: the kind that divides the meadows of Cumbria.
Hedge
A row of bushes (hawthorn, hazel) that marks the boundary between meadows; in Cumbria many are laid by hand.
LIDAR
Measuring the ground with a laser from a plane: it gives the height of the ground and of what stands on it (trees, roofs, walls).
